description: One graded Pick or one graded ParlaySnapshot — the atom of the grading ledger (Quant Apparatus spec §4 contract 6 and §5.2). modelProb is REQUIRED and nullable on purpose: a pick grade carries the leg's recorded locked probability (never backfilled when the leg recorded none), and a parlay grade carries modelProb: null — no single model probability exists for a parlay and none may be invented. result excludes 'void'/'ungraded' — those legs produce no grade record at all (the app's unified record rule). brierContribution is computed by the ledger (Phase B); native on-device grade entries do not carry it yet.

prediction.description: Plain-language label of what was picked, e.g. 'Minnesota Timberwolves — Moneyline'.

selectionId.description: The graded pick's id (pick grades only).

snapshotId.description: The parlay snapshot (ticket) this grade belongs to.

title: GradeRecord
